transcript.content: Hello, it's nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, I came in because... ever since I moved into this new place, this busted-up room I'm renting, things have just been bad. I'm snapping at people all the time. I end up staying up half the night trying to fix leaks or get the heat working, and then... then I'm dragging myself into work late. And I'm messing up stuff on the site that I normally handle with no problem. It's just getting to be too much.
Since moving into this place, have you done anything that seriously broke rules or harmed someone or their property?

No, nothing like that. I mean, I snap at the guys at work sometimes because I'm so tired, but I haven't hurt anybody or wrecked anyone's stuff. I haven't broken any laws or anything. I'm just stressed out, that's all.
Since moving into this place, have you been feeling sad or down?

Not really sad, no. I mean, I'm not sitting around crying or feeling down like that. It's more just... I'm frustrated, you know? Just really stressed out and kind of pissed off about the whole apartment situation and not getting any sleep. But I wouldn't say I feel sad.
Since moving into the apartment, have you been feeling excessively worried or anxious?

No, I wouldn't say anxious. I'm not really worrying about things... it's more just that I'm aggravated. You know, just tired and annoyed that nothing works in that place. But I don't feel nervous or anything like that.
Would you say that irritability and anger have been the main changes you’ve experienced since moving into the apartment?

Yeah, exactly. I mean, I came in here because ever since I moved into that busted-up room, I'm just... I'm snapping at people all the time. I'm staying up half the night trying to fix leaks or get the heat working, and then I'm just dragging myself into work late. And because I'm so tired and aggravated, I'm messing up stuff at work that I normally handle no problem. It's just the stress of it all making me so irritable.
Have you had times when you slept very little but still felt unusually energetic the next day?
No, definitely not. Like I said, I'm staying up half the night messing with the apartment, but the next day I'm just dragging. I don't have any extra energy... I'm just exhausted.
